item.title: IU Health La Porte Hospital offers free glucose screening on March 22
item.description: La Porte, IN 3-18-2011 - In support of Diabetes Alert Day, Indiana University Health La Porte Hospital offers free glucose screenings on Tuesday, March 22 from 7 am to noon at Walmart, 333 Boyd Blvd., La Porte. According to the American Diabetes Association, the screening is highly recommended to identify risks for developing type 2 diabetes.
